verdict.rationale: Hightouch's public REST API is versioned by URL path: the published OpenAPI document pins servers to /api/v1, and the API guide tells developers to call https://api.hightouch.com/api/v1/syncs. The pack contains no documented deprecation policy, sunset timeline, or versioning guarantees, so only the versioning half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle or sunset notices, a changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: to list syncs, send a request to https://api.hightouch.com/api/v1/syncs
